## Summary

- Walr country-routing interstitial pages \(`.cRadio` + `.cRef` + `#btnNext`\) were falling through to `unclassified`, leaving the CTA never clicked
- Add `_is_walr_country_routing_gate\(\)` in `is_consent_screen\(\)` to detect this pattern with 3 tight DOM signals exclusive to Walr
- Add matching `_handle_walr_country_routing_gate\(\)` in `handle_consent_screen\(\)` to click `#btnNext`, with `CTA_INTERCEPT_ONLY` support

## Test plan

- [ ] Load `DOM_original.txt` in a live session — page should classify as `consent_screen` \(not `unclassified`\)
- [ ] `CTA_INTERCEPT_ONLY=1`: handler returns `True` and logs interception without navigating
- [ ] `CTA_INTERCEPT_ONLY=0`: `#btnNext` is clicked and `_wait_change` confirms navigation
- [ ] Non-regression: all 9 reference DOMs in `cases/level_a` unaffected \(none contain `.cRadio`/`.cRef`\)

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)
EOF
